links.outcome: Override rates and calibration with patient-level trust score components (ablation)
links.effect: Removing embedding-space similarity raised override rates from 3.57% to 77–81%; removing confidence calibration improved ECE (0.007 vs 0.024) without meaningfully changing overrides (3.57% vs 3.49%).
links.quote: Systematic ablation identified embedding-space similarity as the architecturally critical trust component: its removal increased override rates from 3.57% to 77–81% across all model sizes, while confidence calibration improved ECE (0.007 vs. 0.024) without meaningfully altering override behavior (3.57% vs. 3.49%).

links.outcome: Override rates when thresholds calibrated for one model are applied to larger models
links.effect: 0% override rates for larger models under thresholds calibrated for the 0.6B model; 3.57% at moderate richness for 0.6B.
links.quote: The 0% override rates observed for larger models under thresholds calibrated for the 0.6B model establish that model-specific threshold recalibration is a structural deployment requirement, not an optional adjustment.
